system-surroundings.def: The system is the part of the universe being studied, usually the reacting particles; the surroundings are everything else, such as the water, container and air.

enthalpy.def: A measure of a system's energy; its change, ΔH, is the energy the system absorbs (positive) or releases (negative) as heat at constant pressure.

exothermic.def: Describes a process that releases energy from the system to the surroundings, so the surroundings warm and ΔH is negative.

endothermic.def: Describes a process that absorbs energy from the surroundings into the system, so the surroundings cool and ΔH is positive.
